verdict.rationale: Vercel AI Gateway lets users export request logs as CSV or JSON and offers an OpenAI-compatible API that avoids lock-in by letting users point existing clients elsewhere with a URL change, which supports open-format portability and easy exit. However, this only covers request/log data, not a full account data export (billing history, configs, keys) and there is no explicit 'export all my data' or account-closure/export feature documented. Missing for 10: comprehensive account data export beyond logs, explicit data-portability/account-deletion documentation, independent verification of export completeness.
